summary: All 8 acceptance criteria exercised: 6 backend tests (pytest, all passed) + 7 browser checks (all passed). No bugs found.

checks.criterion: Login with the demo account works and the session survives navigation
checks.name: test_tscheck_login_session.py::test_login_sets_session_and_me_decks_work
checks.evidence: POST /api/auth/login 200, ds_session cookie set; GET /api/auth/me 200 {email: demo@deckstash.app}; GET /api/decks 200 includes 'My First Import'

checks.criterion: Login with the demo account works and the session survives navigation
checks.name: login-session-survives-navigation
checks.evidence: Logged in via /login form, landed on '/', 'Welcome, demo@deckstash.app' visible; full page reload of '/' still shows header email + 'My First Import' deck; GET /api/decks returned 200 on reload

checks.criterion: Session cookie attributes are correct for the https preview
checks.name: test_tscheck_cookie_attributes.py::test_localhost_cookie_is_samesite_lax + test_https_preview_cookie_is_samesite_none_secure_partitioned
checks.evidence: http://localhost:8001 login Set-Cookie: ds_session=...; SameSite=Lax. https://deck-stash.preview.emergentagent.com login Set-Cookie: ds_session=...; SameSite=None; Secure; Partitioned; HttpOnly

checks.criterion: Signing up a brand-new account also yields a working session
checks.name: signup-new-account-empty-state
checks.evidence: Toggled to 'Create one', signed up with tscheck-<ts>@deckstash.app / tavern123, redirected to '/', header shows new email, empty state 'No decks stashed yet' rendered, no 401 surfaced on /api/decks

checks.criterion: Importing a deck code decodes it
checks.name: import-deck-code-decodes-and-saves
checks.evidence: Pasted seeded deck code into import dialog; decode summary showed Death Knight / Standard / 30 cards / 13440 dust; saved with unique tscheck-import-<ts> name, new card appeared in deck grid

checks.criterion: Importing a deck code decodes it (preview API)
checks.name: test_tscheck_duplicate_deck_code.py::test_preview_decodes_new_code

checks.criterion: Deck detail shows the decoded 30-card list
checks.name: deck-detail-shows-decoded-cards
checks.evidence: Opened newly saved tscheck-detail-<ts> deck; detail page shows Cards=30, Dust=13440, and exactly 21 unique card rows (data-testid^=card-row-)

checks.name: deck-copy-edit-delete
checks.evidence: Copy code showed 'Copied' toast; Edit dialog renamed deck to tscheck-cud-<ts>-renamed with 'Deck updated' toast and name updated in header; Delete (single action, no extra confirm modal) removed the deck from the grid, link no longer visible

checks.name: import-dialog-duplicate-warning
checks.evidence: Pasting the seeded code (already saved as 'My First Import') into a fresh import dialog shows duplicate warning text naming 'My First Import'

checks.criterion: Class filter + search narrow the grid
checks.name: class-filter-and-search-narrow-grid
checks.evidence: Death Knight pill kept 'My First Import' visible; search 'My First Import' matched; search 'zzznomatchdeckname' rendered 'Nothing matches that filter' empty state

checks.criterion: Login with the demo account works (auth negative case)
checks.name: test_tscheck_login_session.py::test_login_wrong_password_rejected

notes: A single 401 console error on GET /api/auth/me appeared in every browser check per spec_deviations — this is the intentional pre-login session probe, not a bug.
Deck delete in the UI executes immediately from the grid's trash icon without a separate confirmation dialog; treated as expected behavior per observed app design, not a defect.
Card art host (art.hearthstonejson.com) reachability was not separately verified; per spec_deviations, blocked art loading in this sandbox would not constitute a bug.
